newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-BELGIUM'S ALBERT TO MISS CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BELGIUM'S ALBERT TO MISS CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Newcastle defender Philippe Albert will miss Belgium's World Cup qualifier against Wales in Cardiff on Saturday due to a knee injury, a Belgian soccer union spokesman said on Tuesday.
It is the second blow in two days for Belgium who lost PSV Eindhoven striker Luc Nilis because of an ankle problem.
National coach Georges Leekens has called up veteran defender Rudi Smidts of Antwerp and Geoffrey Claeys from Feyenoord to complete the 18-man squad.
Defender Olivier Doll and Belgium's 1996 player of the year Franky Van der Elst both have groin problems and are also doubtful.
Belgium must avoid defeat to stay in the running for second place in European qualifying group seven. They are currently third, behind the Netherlands and Wales.
